buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Inspection Pre-dispatch inspection at Seller premises (Fee/Charges to be borne by the BUYER): Before dispatch, the goods will be inspected by Buyer / Consignee or their Authorized Representative or by Nominated External Inspection Agency (independently or jointly with Buyer or Consignee as decided by the Buyer) at Seller premises (or at designated place for inspection as declared / communicated by the seller) for their compliance to the contract specifications. Fee/Charges taken by the External inspection Agency and any external laboratories testing charges shall be borne by the Buyer. For in-house testing, the Sellers will provide necessary facilities free of cost. Seller shall notify the Buyer through e-mail about readiness of goods for pre-dispatch inspection and Buyer will notify the Seller about the Authorized Representative/ Nominated External Inspection Agency and the date for testing. The goods would be dispatched to consignee only after clearance in pre-dispatch inspection. Consignee's right of rejection as per GTC in respect of the goods finally received at his location shall in no way be limited or waived by reason of the goods having previously been inspected, tested and passed by Buyer/ Consignee or its Nominated External Inspection Agency prior to the goods' shipment. While bidding, the sellers should take into account 7 days for inspection from the date of email offering the goods for inspection. Any delay in inspection beyond 7 days shall be on the part of the buyer and shall be regularised without Liquidated Damages. When there is requirement of submission the advance sample, the seller shall inform the buyer promptly through emails about the date of submission of sample to the buyer nominated Inspection agency. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of DCA MRAU payable at AT CHENNAI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

Our File Ref No: DPS/MRPU/1/2/24444 1. Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): RF-PCB Layout design, Compo nent Procurement, Fabrication, Assembly, Testing, Pre-Despatch Inspection, Supply and Wa rranty of Industrial Long Range IEEE 802.15.4 RF Transceiver Board with Antenna Diversity. 2. Bank Guarantee shall be from SBI or any nationalized bank except Gramin/Cooperativ e Bank. 3. Post supply inspection is not allowed. Any offer containing the conditions of post supp ly inspection will be summarily rejected. 4. Terms & Conditions 4.1 Confidentiality and Restriction on Use of Technical Information (applicable after placem ent of Work Order/Purchase Order): • The circuit schematic, design files, layout details and other technical information supplied by IGCAR to the successful bidder for execution of this work shall be used solely for fabricat ion, assembly, testing and delivery of PCBs to IGCAR in accordance with the Work Order/Pu rchase Order. • The successful bidder shall not reproduce, disclose, distribute, transfer or use the said tec hnical information for any purpose other than execution of the work for IGCAR, nor shall it u se the information for manufacturing or supplying PCBs to any other party, without prior written authorization from IGCAR. • The successful bidder shall ensure that its employees, subcontractors, consultants and ot her persons engaged in execution of the work comply with these requirements. Access to t he technical information shall be restricted to persons who require it for execution of the w ork. • This clause shall apply after placement of the Work Order/Purchase Order and shall not b e construed as requiring confidentiality of bid documents that are required to be published or made accessible under applicable GeM and government procurement rules. 4.2 Prohibition against use of IGCAR Name without permission for publicity purp ose: The contractor or subcontractor, consultant, advisor or the employees engaged by the bidd er shall not use IGCAR’s name for any publicity purpose through any public media like a pre ss, radio, T.V or Internet without the prior written approval of IGCAR. 4.3 Sequence of Work: The bidder shall execute the work in consultation with the user in stages of layout making, bare PCB testing, component assembly and PCB testing before and after conformal coating . 4.4 Delivery Schedule: The bidder shall execute the work following the terms and conditions, adhering the delivery schedule and deliver the items. The work shall be completed within 180 days from the date of the purchase order. 4.5 Acceptance Criteria: a) Pre-dispatch Inspection (PDI) i. After completion of fabrication and assembly, the bidder shall intimate IGCAR for PDI.

ii. The bidder shall provide following equipments/ facilities needed for PDI: � RF Laboratory � Vector Network Analyzer � Spectrum Analyzer � RF Signal Generator � Oscilloscope � DC Power Supplies iii. IGCAR engineers shall: � Do Power-on verification � Program the firmware � Conduct RF performance verification. o TX functionality o RX functionality o RF Output Power o Receiver Sensitivity o Spectrum Verification o Antenna Diversity switching. o Carry out communication testing. iv. Boards shall not be dispatched without PDI clearance from IGCAR. b) Acceptance at Purchaser site The units shall be accepted at the Purchaser site only upon successful functional testing. 4.6 Packaging and Transport Packing shall be done keeping in view of the nature and type of the item and conditions of climate, storage, handling and transportation, the consignment is likely to undergo before r eaching the destination. No separate cost will be accepted for packaging and delivery. The budgetary quote should be quoted, inclusive of the packaging and delivery charges. Delive ry should be done to the site. 4.7 Bidder & bid evaluation Criteria: 4.7.1 Submission of duly signed Bidder Compliance Sheet (Annexure II –Table A, B &C)) 4.7.2 Minimum 5 years experience in RF PCB design, fabrication and assembly. Submission of successful completion of at least three RF PCB Work order (submit the WO Copy) operati ng above 1 GHz during the last five years. 4.7.3 Submission of one sample controlled impedance design/calculation report from a prev iously completed RF PCB project (confidential information may be masked).

4.7.4 Availability of calibrated RF test equipment lab at Bidder fabrication/testing site, Main ly following three equipments are needed. Bidder should provide available equipment mod el no /datasheet. o Vector Network Analyzer (≥3 GHz) o Spectrum Analyzer (≥3 GHz) o RF Signal Generator Bidder not satisfying the technical requirement as per the Bidder Compliance sheet (Annex ure II) will be rejected. 4.8 Vendors Scope of Work: a. Component Procurement: i. All components shall be procured strictly as per the approved BOM (Annexure I attached i n technical specification annexure document). ii. Components shall be procured only from OEMs or their authorized distributors (such as M ouser, DigiKey, Farnell, Newark, RS Components or equivalent). iii. Component substitution shall not be permitted without prior approval from IGCAR. iv. Manufacturer's Certificate of Conformance (CoC), invoices and traceability documents fo r critical RF components shall be submitted. b. PCB Design: i. The bidder shall carry out PCB layout based on the schematic supplied by IGCAR. ii. The RF PCB layout shall comply with good RF engineering practices. The layout shall inclu de: � Controlled impedance routing � Optimized RF grounding � Continuous RF reference planes � Minimum RF discontinuities � Minimum loop area � Proper via stitching � Isolation between RF, digital and power sections � Optimized placement of RF matching components � Optimized routing of RF transmission lines � Antenna diversity layout optimization � Minimum EMI and crosstalk iii. The bidder shall submit the following before fabrication: � PCB stack-up � Controlled impedance calculation report � PCB layout

� Design Rule Check (DRC) report iv. Fabrication shall commence only after approval from IGCAR. c. PCB Fabrication: i. The PCB shall be fabricated strictly as per the approved Gerber files. ii. No change in: • PCB stack-up • PCB material • Layer thickness • Copper thickness • Controlled impedance geometry • RF transmission line dimensions shall be permitted without approval from IGCAR. iii. The PCB manufacturer shall comply with the specified PCB fabrication, assembly, inspect ion and testing requirements. iv. The bidder shall submit: • PCB fabrication report • Controlled impedance verification report • Laminate manufacturer's certificates • PCB quality inspection report d. PCB Assembly: i. The bidder shall: • Procure all components. • Assemble all boards using automated SMT assembly. • Perform AOI inspection. • Carry out rework wherever required. • Clean and inspect all boards. ii. Assembly shall comply with IPC-A-610 Class-2 or higher. 4.9 The intellectual property rights of the schematic, PCB layout, Gerber files and all design documents developed under this contract shall remain exclusively with IGCAR. The bidder shall not reuse, reproduce, disclose or manufacture the design for any third party wit hout prior written approval from IGCAR. 4.10 Liquidity Damage: The bidder should complete the work within the time specified in the Indent. In case of non- adherence of delivery schedule, purchaser reserves the right to levy the liquidated damage s as applicable

4.11 IGCAR reserves the right to reject any or all tenders or to allot parts of the work to di fferent agencies without assigning any reasons whatsoever. . 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
